verdict: E-Q35 VERDICT (depth-2 conditional axes — the r24 ideas battery I-3, the last unrun idea; arm C embeds stage-1 measured values in the instructions, arm N names the axes only; 6 relation questions per record over the frozen 8-record subset; AM1 implementation-time: stability read as 3 records per arm, 22 calls total): C33 DIES ON PREMISE-CONTAMINATION — H1 LIVES: THE PROGRAM TEST PASSES with the control contrast doing the work: Spearman(stage-1 dominance, p(subordination)) = 0.703043214869988 WITH the values embedded versus 0.2515015150017844 WITHOUT them — the verdict tracks the measured inputs only when the measurements are in the instructions; the map is programmable and the VALUES are the causal variable. H2 DIES: telling the model its own measurements moved the verdicts beyond the 0.10 drift band on 14/48 paired questions (0.29166666666666663 — the band required <= 25%); median delta 0.07499999999999996, max 0.24; 9 verdict flips cross 0.5. THE CONTAMINATION IS STRUCTURED: R6 family-edge is the most moved (mean 0.18625000000000003), R1 subordination the least (0.045) — the mechanical relation resists the premise while the uncertain ones float with it (P2 HIT). H3 DIES: the best relation separates the A-family at only 0.17166666666666663 versus the best raw axis P7 at 0.72 — the A signature is a MASS pattern, not a relation (P3 MISS). Stability max 0.04999999999999993 (band holds). THE FINDING: THE CONDITIONING CHANNEL IS REAL AND CONTAMINATING — a two-edged instrument; use it for measurement (H1), never for retrieval features (H2's leak).
